verdict.rationale: Docs confirm core PR/code-review features (merge checks, PR screen with third-party reports, Jira ticket creation from PR, AI reviewer suggesting fixes) supporting propose/discuss/merge workflows, and community mentions reference PR usage indirectly. However, no first-party documentation or hands-on evidence details the discussion/comment threads, approval flows, or merge UI specifics beyond high-level marketing claims. missing for 10: detailed PR discussion/commenting mechanics, independent hands-on validation of the merge/review UI, evidence of inline commenting or approval gating in practice.
